claim_label: Is fierce ambivalence a viable professional strategy for women?
description: This conflict examines whether maintaining a critical, detached stance toward corporate systems serves as a form of empowering resistance or a self-defeating barrier to professional advancement.

instances.assertion: No, it is a form of professional paralysis that leaves women behind while others master these tools.
Yes, it is a necessary act of resistance to avoid 'mastering' systems designed for our own marginalization.
